about.body: The AJ200P is a Inline-4 (I4), 2.0L (1,999 cc), Petrol engine used across Land Rover's 5 model range, in production 2016–present. We rebuild every AJ200P to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The AJ200P is fitted across Defender, Discovery, Discovery Sport, Range Rover Evoque, Range Rover Velar — see the full applications table above for exact variants, generations and years.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ200P is fitted across multiple Land Rover models, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation and specification. We confirm by registration or VIN before quoting or supplying anything.
